corrections.was: A wheel cylinder at the parked azimuth plus coaxial steer cylinders, labelled a full 360 deg sweep and rotated 90 deg in loaded-carry and park
corrections.now: A true solid of revolution of the turret radial profile about each steer axis, static in every case
corrections.reason: The rotated blocks were not the envelope their label claimed, and rotating a near-axisymmetric block against housings 4 mm away forced deep exact refinement (25 CPU-minutes in loaded-carry) without adding occupied volume

corrections.was: The STEP held the pipe at the station exit while the motion study assumed it at the stow seat
corrections.now: The STEP holds the pipe at its stow seat; receive cases offset it to the station exit
corrections.reason: carriedWith requires the payload and carrier to share the same initial pose; the first fail-fast run caught the double offset (receive-chute, 7695 mm3 with feed panel 1)

corrections.was: One fused block of 150 per-body boxes spanning the robot
corrections.now: Perimeter, lower cassettes, pan trusses and stringers, and sills/decks/crossmembers as separate partitioned reserves
corrections.reason: Box culling could not clear any moving pair against a whole-robot bounding box; same per-body boxes and allowances
